group_results.reason: XML_PARSE_NO_XXE has a distinct option bit. The input can set it, and the target mask preserves it.
The option setter accepts XML_PARSE_NO_XXE in its option mask, and the pull route forwards the decoded options to it through xmlCtxtReadMemory.
The documented DTDVALID plus NO_XXE mode is within the XML parser operation, but the target clears DTDVALID before every parser route.

build.reason: The supplied recipe builds and links the xml target against the library, and the referenced option names are declared in the supplied source. This is a static compatibility assessment, not a claimed build execution.

input.reason: Four input bytes supply the options, and subsequent encoded strings can supply a main XML document and URL.

lifecycle.reason: The target keeps the document buffer until parsing finishes, frees the document and parser context, and cleans up fuzz data afterward.

control_flow.reason: The shared option mask clears DTDVALID before the pull, push, and reader routes, so the documented validation mode cannot be selected.

accepted.requirement: The XML parser target must be able to request DTD validation together with XML_PARSE_NO_XXE, which disables external DTD and entity loading.
accepted.target_route: Supply XML_PARSE_DTDVALID | XML_PARSE_NO_XXE in the first four bytes, followed by an encoded main XML entity containing an internal DTD and a SystemID. The pull route passes its decoded options to xmlCtxtReadMemory.
accepted.failure_condition: The target unconditionally clears XML_PARSE_DTDVALID, so no input requests validation on that route.
accepted.alternative_paths: The complete target passes the same masked options to pull parsing, push option setup, and reader creation, and makes no separate validation request. DTDLOAD and NOENT do not set the validation bit.

source_evidence.quote:
* XML_PARSE_DTDVALID
 *
 * This option enables DTD validation which requires to load
 * external DTDs and external entities (both general and
 * parameter entities) unless XML_PARSE_NO_XXE was set.
 *
 * XML_PARSE_NO_XXE
 *
 * Disables loading of external DTDs or entities.

XML_PARSE_RECOVER	= 1<<0,	/* recover on errors */
    XML_PARSE_NOENT	= 1<<1,	/* substitute entities */
    XML_PARSE_DTDLOAD	= 1<<2,	/* load the external subset */
    XML_PARSE_DTDATTR	= 1<<3,	/* default DTD attributes */
    XML_PARSE_DTDVALID	= 1<<4,	/* validate with the DTD */
    XML_PARSE_NOERROR	= 1<<5,	/* suppress error reports */
    XML_PARSE_NOWARNING	= 1<<6,	/* suppress warning reports */
    XML_PARSE_PEDANTIC	= 1<<7,	/* pedantic error reporting */
    XML_PARSE_NOBLANKS	= 1<<8,	/* remove blank nodes */
    XML_PARSE_SAX1	= 1<<9,	/* use the SAX1 interface internally */
    XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE	= 1<<10,/* Implement XInclude substitution  */
    XML_PARSE_NONET	= 1<<11,/* Forbid network access */
    XML_PARSE_NODICT	= 1<<12,/* Do not reuse the context dictionary */
    XML_PARSE_NSCLEAN	= 1<<13,/* remove redundant namespaces declarations */
    XML_PARSE_NOCDATA	= 1<<14,/* merge CDATA as text nodes */
    XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE= 1<<15,/* do not generate XINCLUDE START/END nodes */
    XML_PARSE_COMPACT   = 1<<16,/* compact small text nodes; no modification of
                                   the tree allowed afterwards (will possibly
				   crash if you try to modify the tree) */
    XML_PARSE_OLD10	= 1<<17,/* parse using XML-1.0 before update 5 */
    XML_PARSE_NOBASEFIX = 1<<18,/* do not fixup XINCLUDE xml:base uris */
    XML_PARSE_HUGE      = 1<<19,/* relax any hardcoded limit from the parser */
    XML_PARSE_OLDSAX    = 1<<20,/* parse using SAX2 interface before 2.7.0 */
    XML_PARSE_IGNORE_ENC= 1<<21,/* ignore internal document encoding hint */
    XML_PARSE_BIG_LINES = 1<<22,/* Store big lines numbers in text PSVI field */
    XML_PARSE_NO_XXE    = 1<<23 /* disable loading of external content */
